fieldDescription: How many research points you gain each time a Liminal event stage completes. Not retroactive. You may want to change when the crisis begins below.
[Will affect balance a lot] Multiplier on the monthly credit cost of Liminal Templates.
[Will affect balance a lot] Multiplier on how many OP of Instructions you can fit inside templates.

If total monthly Liminality upkeep (research investment + template upkeep) goes above this many credits, research investment and all templates are automatically disabled, the same as running out of credits. Set to 0 to disable the cap.

[Will affect balance a lot] 0 = each Liminal Template's Instruction capacity is derived from the template hullmod's OP cost as normal. Above 0, this value replaces the derived capacity for EVERY template (the post-crisis bonus and the Template OP Multiplier above still apply on top, and the RP unlock cost of still-locked templates scales up with it). The template hullmod's own OP cost when fitted to a ship is unaffected.
Whether the Liminal super endgame crisis is enabled.
How many RP before the crisis begins.

Crisis difficulty. Note, higher difficulties will be more computationally intensive. Good computers are recommended for the highest settings. Recommendations:
- Easy: Vanilla
- Standard: 50-100 balanced mods
- Hard: 200+ unbalanced mods

[Will affect balance a lot] Chance for each ship in a non-Liminal NPC fleet to gain a Liminal Connection hullmod when you encounter that fleet, once the crisis has begun. Before the crisis begins the chance ramps up to 25%%/50%% of this value as research progresses. Does not affect the Liminal faction's own fleets. WARNING: raising this means many more Liminality-influenced ships in battles, and they are recoverable afterwards.

[Restart the game after changing] How computationally intensive the final boss is. Lower numbers will decrease the scale of the boss, but the overall difficulty will be the same or slightly higher. Values above 0.5 are not recommended.

[Restart the game after changing] Boss difficulty. Higher difficulties are slightly more computationally intensive. Recommendations:
- Easy: Vanilla
- Standard: 50-100 balanced mods
- Hard: 200+ unbalanced mods
